_doc: Keys and readable notes of the Dunmore Timber truck depot (w4_logging_truck_depot), forest set pieces round 4. Note items are note_<note id> (notes/wild4_depot.json); models from tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/items_wild4_depot.py.

defs.name: Shop Key Ring
defs.description: Hank's key ring: a steel ring of truck keys and one brass padlock key on a leather fob stamped PARTS. It was in the inspection pit, on the creeper beside him.

defs.name: Dispatch Office Key
defs.description: A brass deadbolt key with a paper tag in the dispatcher's hand: OFFICE - SPARE. It hung on a nail over the parts counter.
